svg.title: rangle cloud architecture — presentation staging
svg.desc: Browsers resolve app.rangleplay.stream and media.rangleplay.stream through DNS-only Cloudflare records and connect directly to a Google global HTTPS load balancer. The app uses a serverless NEG and Cloud Run in Tokyo, reading a private catalog through read-only Cloud Storage FUSE. Media uses Cloud CDN with a private Cloud Storage origin, bypassing Go. GitHub Actions deploys with Workload Identity Federation. A scheduled workflow checks budget messages and the deadline to stop owned serving resources.
svg.text: Application and media delivery on Google Cloud
cache fill on miss · CDN identity
Large media goes directly through the CDN
Single global IPv4 · HTTP to HTTPS
Separate private buckets: inputs / weights + Terraform state
Terraform owns infra / IAM / catalog / mount / scaling
Stop owned Run + LB entry · disable deploy SA
USD 300 authorized · Billing notifications are not a hard cap
